facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.make_atari_env: create an Atari environment with frame skipping and optional no-op reset using make_atari
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.wrap_deepmind_env: wrap an Atari environment with DeepMind-style preprocessing including frame warping and reward clipping
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.wrap_pytorch_env: wrap a gym environment to swap image axes for PyTorch channel-first format
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.get_env_type: get the environment type and canonical env ID from a gym environment ID string
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.review_EpisodicLifeEnv: review the EpisodicLifeEnv wrapper that makes loss of life equivalent to end of episode

facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.create_environment_wrapper: create an Environment wrapper around a gym env to track episode return, steps, and wins
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.use_minigrid2image_wrapper: use the Minigrid2Image observation wrapper to extract only the image channel from a Minigrid env
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.stack_frames_with_framestack: stack the last k frames from a gym env using the FrameStack wrapper for temporal context
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.optimize_memory_with_lazyframes: optimize replay buffer memory by using LazyFrames to defer concatenation of stacked frames
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.get_full_grid_observation: get the full Minigrid grid observation with the agent position marked in red

facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.compute_baseline_loss: compute the baseline loss from advantage values using mean squared advantages across timesteps
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.compute_entropy_loss: compute the entropy loss from policy logits to encourage exploration via softmax entropy
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss from logits, actions, and advantages using weighted cross entropy
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.compute_forward_dynamics_loss: compute the forward dynamics loss by measuring L2 norm between predicted and actual next embeddings
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.compute_inverse_dynamics_loss: compute the inverse dynamics loss by classifying predicted actions against true actions using cross entropy

facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.build_FullObsMinigridPolicyNet: build a FullObsMinigridPolicyNet model with observation shape and num actions for fully observed Minigrid environments
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.build_MinigridPolicyNet: build a MinigridPolicyNet model with LSTM core for partial observation Minigrid policy learning
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.build_MinigridStateEmbeddingNet: build a MinigridStateEmbeddingNet to extract state embeddings from partial observation frames
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.build_MinigridInverseDynamicsNet: build a MinigridInverseDynamicsNet to predict action logits from state and next state embeddings
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.build_MarioDoomPolicyNet: build a MarioDoomPolicyNet model with LSTM core for Mario or Doom policy learning

facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.get_batch_from_queues: get a batch of tensors from full and free queues for training with device transfer
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.create_buffers_shared_memory: create shared memory buffers for frames, rewards, actions, and state counts across processes
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.run_actor_process: run an actor process that collects rollouts, updates state counts, and writes to shared buffers
facebookresearch_impact-driven-explorati.review_act_function: review the act function for count-based exploration logic and episode state tracking
